profile.reading: Per QTS own site, this Atlanta Data Center 2 facility (DC2) is located at 1025 Jefferson St NW, Atlanta, GA 30318, part of a 99 acre campus with 278 MW+ total critical power capacity across 4 buildings.
profile.capacity_note: Part of QTS Atlanta 1, a 99 acre campus with 278 MW+ total critical power capacity across 4 buildings (DC1-DC4) (per operators own site); campus total, not per-building. This registry only has entries for Data Center 1 and Data Center 2.
profile.research_note: Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 21 (mega-operator no-sources-key gap, QTS Loudoun/Prince William/GA/OH campus pass): added address and campus capacity from the operators own site. research_status remains complete.
profile.regional_context: QTS was founded 2003, HQ Overland Park KS, acquired by Blackstone for ~$10B in 2021.
profile.facility_type_note: Part of QTS's Atlanta-area campus, spanning Atlanta proper, Fayette County, and Gwinnett County, Georgia. Georgia (Atlanta) was one of QTS's earliest markets, per Wikipedia's account of the company's 2005-2007 acquisition-driven expansion.
